Name: Zuph, Father of Toah
Summary: Father of Toah and son of Elkanah in Heman's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:35: Father of Toah and son of Elkanah in Heman's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zuph in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
